user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Used to surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt to opt out of ChatGPT search answers.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.opt_out: Not specified in documentation.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train OpenAI's generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content that may be used to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions triggered by user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions and visits from ChatGPT, Custom GPTs, and GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply because actions are initiated by a user.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web content used for generative AI model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites at users' direction when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user-initiated requests in Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed specifically to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for building Google's search indexes and performing general analysis.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images and other visual search features.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and image features in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for video-related search features and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls news content for Google News surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects the Google News product, including news.google.com and the app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls merchant content for Google Shopping features.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Affects Search testing tools in Search Console; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible web content for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect specific products; used by various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect specific products; optimized version of GoogleOther for images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect specific products; optimized version of GoogleOther for videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Performs crawls requested by site owners to build Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls for Vertex AI Agents; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Affects training for Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler that gathers and indexes information automatically.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: User agent that gathers information in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and indexes web content.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and rendering for Apple ecosystem services like Spotlight, Siri, and Safari.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for training Apple general-purpose foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Determines usage permissions for data crawled by Applebot for AI training without crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls registered podcast content.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content of apps or websites shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information such as title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and business-related products.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for use cases such as improving advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models and indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Used for training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches links at user request and helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are requested by the user.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: General web content used for improving products, services, and training AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Web content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt directives.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports live user actions, such as responding to Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web information fetched on a user's behalf; not for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler collecting open datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Samples web pages across the Internet to build open datasets stored on Amazon S3.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rule for CCBot in robots.txt or use the opt-out registry.
